name: @linguacast/codegen
description: Holds openapi-typescript and the TypeScript 5 it peer-depends on, isolated from the rest of the monorepo. openapi-typescript uses the TS compiler's AST factory API (ts.factory), which the TypeScript 7 package does not expose, so it cannot run in a package that resolves typescript@7. Nothing here typechecks source; @linguacast/contract's gen:types invokes the CLI from this package.
